赵爷爷跟老人做了个自我介绍，还跟老人详细说了说小丫头的拜师问题。就在两个老头聊天的时候，王野已经拉着小姑娘回到了床边。王野把李主任带的网兜放在床头的柜子上。看了一眼，这李主任还真出血了，一瓶麦乳精，两袋奶粉，一袋白糖，一袋红糖，还有十来个苹果，就这份礼品，就算去看个领导都不寒酸。

王野坐在床边才第一次正式的打量起了小姑娘，这个姑娘长得并不是特别漂亮，可是那双眼睛特别亮。王野现在可不会摸骨，但是王野猜测，应该是摸一摸关节的灵活度，和四肢骨骼的比例。王野还猜测是不是也要摸一摸跟腱和肌肉的密度。因为王野知道前世的时候，有个运动员的跟腱就特别长。

王野见小姑娘一直盯着他，王野就说：“小姑娘，我叫王野，你可以叫我王野哥哥，也可以叫我师兄。”

谁知道小姑娘立刻就叫了一声师兄。王野心想：”这小姑娘不错呀，脑子绝对够用。“

王野接着说：”我都告诉你我叫什么了，你是不是也应该告诉我你叫什么呀？”

小丫头倒是一点都不认生：“师兄，我叫杨璎珞，你可以叫我小璎。”

王野又看了看床上的小男孩，杨璎珞说：“我弟弟叫杨琮。我爹说是宝石的意思。”

王野笑呵呵的说：“你的名字也挺好呀，用珠玉串成的项链。”

小姑娘笑了笑说：“我也觉得很好，爹说我和弟弟的名字都是请先生起的。”

王野可以想象的到，在这个狗剩遍地走的时代，有一位父亲花钱请人给孩子起名，说明这位父亲是多爱他的孩子。王野也能想象到这位父亲在临死的瞬间，是多么的不舍，多么的放心不下。

杨璎珞见王野不说话了，就开始给弟弟换额头上的毛巾。王野回过神来后问：“小璎，你弟弟得病怎么样了？”

杨璎珞立刻开心的说：“医生今天说我弟弟很快就好了。”

王野笑了笑，心想：“这一句和没说一样，到底还是个孩子。“小璎从昨晚给王野的印象，让他忽略了这只是个十岁的孩子。

赵爷爷和老人约好，等杨琮的病好了，就让老人带着杨璎珞去拜师。几人又寒暄了了几句，王野和赵爷爷就回家了。在回家的路上，王野推着自行车，赵爷爷跟着，两人边走边聊。

“小野，你为什么想把小姑娘收进门，别说什么可怜他们。从今天工厂的慰问看，这姐弟俩将来不会太难。”

王野“嘿嘿”一笑说：“还是赵爷爷了解我。，要是我真怜悯他们，隔三差五的给点东西也就够了。我这是见您老说这丫头是个练武的材料，才想给他收进门的。”

赵爷爷嘴角上扬，又问：“不光这个原因吧？”

Grandpa Zhao introduced himself to the old man, and also told the old man in detail about the little girl's apprenticeship.While the two old men were chatting, Wang Ye had already pulled the little girl back to the bed.Wang Ye put the net bag brought by Director Li on the bedside cabinet.After taking a look, Director Li was really bleeding. He had a bottle of malted milk, two bags of milk powder, a bag of white sugar, a bag of brown sugar, and a dozen apples. With this gift, it was not shabby even if he went to see the leader.

Wang Ye sat by the bed and took a formal look at the little girl for the first time. The girl was not particularly beautiful, but her eyes were particularly bright.Wang Ye doesn't know how to feel bones now, but Wang Ye guesses that he should feel the flexibility of the joints and the proportions of the limb bones.Wang Ye also wondered whether he should also feel the density of the Achilles tendon and muscles.Because Wang Ye knew that in his previous life, there was an athlete whose Achilles tendon was particularly long.

When Wang Ye saw the little girl staring at him, Wang Ye said, "Little girl, my name is Wang Ye. You can call me brother Wang Ye, or you can call me senior brother."

Who knew that the little girl immediately called her senior brother.Wang Ye thought: "This little girl is pretty good, she definitely has enough brains."

Wang Ye continued: "I told you my name, shouldn't you also tell me your name?"

The little girl didn't recognize her life at all: "Senior brother, my name is Yang Yingluo, you can call me Xiaoying."

Wang Ye looked at the little boy on the bed again, and Yang Yingluo said, "My brother's name is Yang Cong. My father said it means gem."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Your name is pretty good too. It's a necklace made of pearls and jade."

The little girl smiled and said, "I think it's good too. Dad said that my brother and I were named by our husband."

Wang Ye could imagine that in this era where dogs are everywhere, a father pays someone to name his child, which shows how much the father loves his child.Wang Ye could also imagine how reluctant and uneasy his father was at the moment of his death.

Seeing that Wang Ye was silent, Yang Yingluo began to change the towel on her brother's forehead.Wang Ye came to his senses and asked: "Xiaoying, how is your brother's illness?"

Yang Yingluo immediately said happily: "The doctor said today that my brother will be fine soon."

Wang Ye smiled and thought: "It's as if I didn't say this. After all, I'm still a child." The impression Xiaoying gave Wang Ye last night made him ignore that this was just a ten-year-old child.

Grandpa Zhao made an appointment with the old man, and when Yang Cong recovered from his illness, he would let the old man take Yang Yingluo to become a disciple.After a few more pleasantries, Wang Ye and Grandpa Zhao went home.On the way home, Wang Ye pushed his bicycle, and Grandpa Zhao followed. The two chatted while walking.

"Xiaoye, why do you want to take the little girl in? Don't say anything about pitying them. Judging from the condolences from the factory today, it will not be too difficult for the siblings in the future."

Wang Ye said with a "hehe" smile: "Grandpa Zhao understands me. If I really pity them, it would be enough to give them something every now and then. I saw you always saying that this girl is a martial arts material, so I wanted to let him in."

Grandpa Zhao raised the corner of his mouth and asked again: "Isn't this the only reason?"
